name: data-form-app
description: Data Form App — monorepo (NestJS API + React web)

scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @data-form/shared && npm run start:dev -w @data-form/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @data-form/shared && npm run dev -w @data-form/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @data-form/shared && npm run build -w @data-form/api && npm run build -w @data-form/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @data-form/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
